study type: secondary analysis of a randomized trial
exposure: subcuticular skin closure with either 4-0 Monocryl or 4-0 Vicryl
outcome: superficial or deep surgical site infection
cohort: 871 women undergoing cesarean delivery who had subcuticular suture closure with either 4-0 Monocryl or 4-0 Vicryl
finding: Subcuticular skin closure with 4-0 Vicryl is associated with comparable rates of surgical site infection and other wound complications as 4-0 Monocryl.
